newsitem.title: UK: Mowlem to float 49 pct of offshoot - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mowlem to float 49 pct of offshoot - paper.

text.p: Construction group John Mowlem Plc will announce on Wednesday it plans to float 49 percent of its SGB scaffolding-to-ladders unit through a share placing, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

The placing was expected to value the business at over 100 million stg ($162.3 million), and Mowlem would use the proceeds to redeem a 50 million stg Eurobond with an 11.5 percent interest coupon, the newspaper said.

"We believe SGB will be better placed to raise capital and attract quality management as an independent company, leaving Mowlem to concentrate its efforts on running its core businesses," chief executive John Gains was quoted as saying.
